name: Orcarchy — Omarchy Sync (development preview)
description: Live Omarchy color synchronization. Requires the Orcarchy appearance-provider source extension; stock Orca is not supported yet. Python 3.11+ required.

settings.title: Automatic synchronization
settings.description: Follow Omarchy on startup and while running. Disable to leave the current appearance unchanged.

settings.title: Colors
settings.description: Synchronize application, editor, and terminal colors through the experimental host API.

settings.title: Fonts (not available in this preview)
settings.description: Requested by default; no font settings are changed until family-only host support is implemented.

settings.title: Backgrounds (not available in this preview)
settings.description: Requested by default; no background or opacity settings are changed in this preview.
